summary: Relmada Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that the employment of Dr. Raj S. Pruthi, Chief Medical Officer, Urology, ended on September 3, 2026. The filing, signed by CEO Sergio Traversa, provides no stated reason, no successor or interim appointment, and no severance or transition terms. No advisor, board recommendation, or financial mechanics are disclosed. As an abrupt senior clinical leadership departure reported via a bare current report, the event leaves a key urology program role vacant; watch for subsequent disclosures on interim coverage, program timing, or a broader management shake-up.
